title: Example 14-6: Unenclosed Stage Directions

illustrates.quote: Do not insert blank lines before or after stage directions or cues printed outside or between the lines of dialogue.

blocks.speaker: JESSIE
blocks.text: JESSIE: It’s not a joke, Mama.
Mama watches for a moment in silence.

blocks.speaker: MAMA
blocks.text: MAMA: That gun’s no good, you know. He broke it right before he died. He dropped it in the mud one day.

print.notes: A stage direction printed between two speeches, not enclosed in any punctuation; speaker names are in full capitals followed by a colon.
print.printFeatures: Speaker names in full capitals followed by a colon; the stage direction between them is in italics in print (dropped per 14.5.3c since it is unenclosed and needs no distinction here).
